outcome: Invoking a function template ref does not register the surrounding render as a dependency of whatever the callback reads

acceptance_criteria.text: A function template ref that reads reactive state while being invoked does not cause the surrounding component to re-render when that state changes.

expected_verification.assertion: a component whose function ref reads a ref does not re-render when that ref is written

acceptance_criteria.text: The ref callback still receives the element or component instance it received before, and still runs on the renders it ran on before.

expected_verification.assertion: the existing template-ref tests still pass
